climate: Humidity and salt air cause mold and rust, so check bathrooms, window frames and appliances; look for termite damage and ask whether the unit has air conditioning.
fact: Many Honolulu rentals are condos, so the building's house rules on pets, parking and moving times also apply to tenants.
